title: Path to category
lead: Your category is your specialization and grade confirmed by the test. Employers search by category, so without one you do not appear in shortlists.

direction.title: Which direction do you want to work in?
direction.hint: The test and the category are built for the direction. Industries of interest can be set in your profile.

grade.title: Which grade are you aiming for?
grade.hint: Hint from your profile: {{grade}}. You choose the grade, the test decides the category.
grade.startEmpty: Pick a grade to start the test

how.title: How the test works
how.length: From {{min}} to {{max}} tasks: the test ends once your level is precise.
how.leave: You can leave: the test resumes from the same task.
how.server: Answers are checked on the server and response time is recorded.
how.result: If there is not enough confidence for the chosen grade, you continue at the grade below and your answers still count.

inProgress.title: The {{grade}} test is in progress
inProgress.text: Answer the remaining tasks to get your category.

offer.title: Not enough confidence for {{grade}}
offer.text: Continue at {{offer}}: your previous answers count and a few easier tasks are added. If they are enough, you get the category right away.

none.title: No category yet
none.text: There was not enough confidence even for intern. You can retake the test from {{date}}; meanwhile focus on the topics where your level is lower.

reveal.label: Your category
reveal.lead: The test confirmed your level. Employers now see you in shortlists for this category.
reveal.notPassedText: There is not enough confidence for the higher grade yet. The attempt is not burnt: the next one opens later, and the result has already refined your skill profile.
